description:
One executed-and-passing test run, recorded against the bound Work Session.

``completed_at`` is deliberately not a field — the server stamps it. The only
hash key is ``output_sha256``; the server maps it onto the gate's accepted set.
``head_sha``/``branch`` are optional cross-checks: when given they must match
the Work Session, and the persisted record is always pinned to the session's
own values.

branch.description: Optional cross-check; must match the session branch.
branch.title: Branch

commands.description: The exact command(s) that ran, in order. At least one.
commands.title: Commands

exit_code.description: Process exit code of the run (0 == pass).
exit_code.title: Exit Code

head_sha.description: Optional cross-check; must match the session head_sha.
head_sha.title: Head Sha

output_sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 over the combined run output/log.
output_sha256.title: Output Sha256

passed.description: True only if every command passed.
passed.title: Passed

task_id.description: Board task this evidence belongs to.
task_id.title: Task Id

work_session_id.description: The BOUND Work Session; a forked session cannot satisfy the gate.
work_session_id.title: Work Session Id

title: RecordExecutedTestRunCommand
